name: Logseq
description: Logseq is a privacy-first knowledge management app with bidirectional links, outlines, local-first graphs, and an official Docker-hosted webapp for browser-based access.

notes.text: Remote Logseq web access requires HTTPS and a browser that supports the File System Access API.
This helper uses a self-signed certificate for `https://<IP>`. For demo use on a local network, continue through the browser warning page.
This script hosts the official Logseq web app only. It does not provide Logseq Sync or server-side graph storage.
